The perks your app checks for, which products grant: list, create, edit and delete them. 'voidhash
product perks set' chooses the perks a product grants.

Usage:
  voidhash perk <command> [flags]

Aliases:
  perk, perks

Commands:
  list       List the project's perks and the products that grant each.
  create     Create a perk, the access your app checks for.
  edit       Rename a perk or change the slug your app checks for.
  delete     Delete a perk, which everyone who has it loses.

Flags:
  -h, --help  Show help for this command

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Run 'voidhash perk <command> --help' for more about a command.
